_about: 功法 — the learned arts. Each is one effect in the fight from duel.js (never a number), a source line from 道教 heritage, and the tier it asks for. Learned, never bought and never taught by a beast: a scene exit grants one (`grant.art`) — a person teaches it, or a task earns it. A made world may rename these words, never invent an effect.

about.zh: 掎出的符化水入丹田：每用一符，灵力回一半法术。
about.en: A cast talisman turns to water for the dantian: each 符 spent gives back 灵力.

source.en: Book of the Later Han — the Way of Great Peace healed with talisman water

about.zh: 雷落为木，倍于法术，不计其抗。一战一用。
about.en: Thunder falls as 木, at double 法术, and no 抗 blunts it. Once a fight.

source.en: Daofa Huiyuan — the Five Thunders of the Divine Empyrean

about.zh: 佩剑一气连击两下。一战一用。
about.en: The worn sword strikes twice in one breath. Once a fight.

source.en: Biographies of Immortals — release by the sword
